items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I never seen him perform because he didn't want to talk.

ctx.x: Well, Nicodemus, he was supposed to have been a great comedian. but he... I never seen him perform because he didn't want to talk. And I couldn't... It was a mystery to me how he survived, how he made money to live.
Well, he was on the type of...the Stepin' Fetchit type of thing.
